name: Sevalla Database Hosting
line: Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, and vector-enabled Postgres.

free.text: One-off $20 credit; expiry says 2 or 30 days; services bill after it ends

cells.regions: 20 OCI or 25 Google regions, by company migration

sql.math: $34 for the DB2 runtime, + $0.02 per GB of backup storage a month, for an amount not yet known. The 5 GB of database transfer is free, but how much backup space is used is unknown.
While online, DB2 stays at $34, plus $0.02 per GB of backup storage a month. A manual suspension stops the database runtime, but the data stays unavailable.

files.math: Sevalla database hosting is separate from its object storage.

jobs.math: Database hosting does not run worker jobs.
